name: SSHI_LC_Filter
rationale: The previous SSHI_FBR design produced ample power (well over 200%) but failed the 'settled' check because the storage capacitor C1 was too large, leading to a time constant (RL*C1) that prevented the output from reaching steady state within 0.8s. To fix this, I am introducing an LC filter at the output. The inductor L2 will suppress the ripple, allowing for a significantly smaller C1. A smaller C1 will reduce the time constant, ensuring the output settles quickly, while L2 keeps the peak-to-peak ripple within the 50mV limit.
